name: hertz-service
description: Complete API (HTTP) service on CloudWeGo Hertz: routes generated from the Thrift IDL with hz, clients for the RPC services behind it, Nacos registration, logging with a trace_id, config, Makefile codegen, CI for GitHub Actions and/or GitLab CI, Dockerfile. Used by `devkit nas`.

vars.name: Service
vars.description: Service name, lowercase with dashes (e.g. order, order-item)

vars.name: Module
vars.description: Go module path of the new service (e.g. github.com/sezznaw/order)

vars.name: CommonModule
vars.description: Module path of the shared common library. Decided by the template for every service; cannot be set per service or project

vars.name: CommonVersion
vars.description: Version of common to require. Decided by the template for every service; cannot be set per service or project

vars.name: IdlRepo
vars.description: Path of the shared IDL project as CI sees it (owner/repo on GitHub, group/project on GitLab). Empty: <owner or group of the service>/idl

vars.name: CI
vars.description: Which CI configuration to generate: github, gitlab, both or none. ngs detects it from module_prefix / idl_repo

vars.name: GoPrivate
vars.description: GOPRIVATE pattern when the organisation's modules are private (empty = public)

vars.name: Port
vars.description: HTTP port the service listens on

vars.name: NacosAddr
vars.description: Address of the Nacos on a developer's own machine, written to conf/local.yaml

vars.name: GoVersion
vars.description: Go release (major.minor) for go.mod, the Docker image and GitLab CI; must not be lower than what devkit-common requires. Decided by the template for every service; cannot be set per service or project

vars.name: KitexVersion
vars.description: Kitex version, for the clients of the RPC services this API calls. Decided by the template for every service; cannot be set per service or project

vars.name: HertzVersion
vars.description: Hertz version. Decided by the template for every service; cannot be set per service or project

vars.name: HzVersion
vars.description: Version of hz, the Hertz code generator. Decided by the template for every service; cannot be set per service or project

vars.name: ThriftgoVersion
vars.description: thriftgo tool version. Decided by the template for every service; cannot be set per service or project

post_install: if command -v hz >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v thriftgo >/dev/null 2>&1; then make gen && go mod tidy; else echo '>> hz/thriftgo not installed. Run: make tools && make gen && go mod tidy'; fi
post_update: go get github.com/cloudwego/hertz@v0.10.6 github.com/cloudwego/kitex@v0.16.3 github.com/sezznaw/devkit-common@v0.12.0 && go mod tidy

changes: devkit-common v0.12.0: scheduled jobs. app/jobs.go (yours, created once) lists the jobs: a name, a cron schedule in UTC, a timeout and a function. main.go understands `--list-jobs` (the CI stores the list next to the image tag and the deployment makes a Kubernetes CronJob of each job) and `--job=<name>` (what the CronJob runs: the framework opens what the configuration enables, runs the job with a root span, a run_id in the log, a Redis lock against overlap and the timeout, and exits 1 on failure; no server, no Nacos registration). `make jobs` lists them, `make job NAME=<name>` runs one on your machine.
action: An existing service has no app/jobs.go yet, and the new main.go needs it: copy app/jobs.go from a new service (`devkit ngs` into a scratch directory) or from the template, and `go mod tidy`. With an empty list nothing is scheduled; the CI still writes an empty jobs file.

changes: devkit-common v0.11.0: the kafka: and centrifugo: sections (off) like in every service; a gateway typically enables centrifugo to sign connection tokens for logged-in clients (deps.Runtime.Centrifugo.ConnectionToken).
devkit-common v0.10.0: the `redis:` section (off) like in every service; deps.Runtime has rt.Redis when enabled.

devkit-common v0.9.0: main.go builds a kitexx.Runtime and passes it to hertzx.New(rt) and app.Setup(cfg, rt, h); deps.Runtime holds it. A gateway normally has no database of its own, but the `mysql:` section is there (off) like in every service.

BREAKING for an existing service: after `devkit update` change app.Setup to `func Setup(cfg *Config, rt *kitexx.Runtime, h *server.Hertz)` and add `var Runtime *kitexx.Runtime` to deps/deps.go (set it first thing in Setup).

devkit-common v0.8.0: OpenTelemetry tracing. With `otel.endpoint` set (the deployment sets OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT) every request is a server span named like `GET /user/:id`, continuing the caller's W3C traceparent, and the RPC clients the handler calls make child spans; X-Trace-Id stays, and one that is 32 hex characters is the id of the trace. Empty endpoint: nothing changes.

a service created with `devkit nas` compiles after the first route is added. hz adds the function for a new method to handler/<name>/<name>_service.go and refers to the request and response structs by the name of their package (ser_api.LoginReq), while the handler the template created imported that package as `api`; the first `make gen` after an IDL change left code that did not build. New services import it under its own name
action:
handler/ is yours and is not rewritten, so a service created with 0.1.0 needs this once, in handler/<name>/<name>_service.go: change the import
	api "<module>/hertz_gen/<name>"
to
	<name> "<module>/hertz_gen/<name>"
(<name> with _ instead of -, e.g. ser_api) and replace `api.PingReq` and `api.PingResp` by `<name>.PingReq` and `<name>.PingResp`.

changes: first version: an API service on Hertz, created with `devkit nas <name>`. The HTTP API is defined in the project's Thrift IDL (api.get, api.post, ...), `make gen` generates routes and structs with hz and the clients of the RPC services it calls with kitex; configuration, Nacos, logging and the graceful stop are those of an RPC service
